undeclared.decision: Discard every slice loop below 0.001 normalized area, including holes and separate material components.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-013 declares the rectangle-filter choice but omits this cutoff. Study part 00140273 has 67 components at x=0, all with areas between approximately 0.000216 and 0.000240; all disappear from the extracted sketches. An empty extraction therefore need not mean an empty section.

undeclared.decision: Treat every contour enclosed by the largest contour as a hole, without distinguishing material islands nested inside holes.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This occurs in study part 00095369 at z=0. Its two material profiles have total area approximately 3.21767, but grouping produces outer_area approximately 4 and hole_areas approximately [3.36639, 2.58405]. The second alleged hole is material; subtracting the reported holes gives a negative area.

undeclared.decision: Normalize the supplied plane normal while leaving offset unchanged.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The advertised equation is dot(p, normal)=offset, but the implementation interprets offset as distance along a unit normal. For normal=[0,0,2], offset=0.2, it slices z=0.2 instead of z=0.1. No unit-normal requirement is declared.

undeclared.decision: Give the no-LLM control uncharged exact-IoU evaluations of every candidate union and cut; count only accepted additions as tool calls.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-017 declares greedy assembly and a shared call budget, but not this additional access to ground-truth evaluations. The 00046097 smoke episode records 17 calls while its 11 candidates undergo 66 additional trial add/cut scores across three assembly sweeps. The recorded call count excludes that search.

undeclared.decision: Truncate older assistant text and string-valued tool arguments as well as tool results, and reduce retained results from six to three to one after context-length errors.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-020 correctly records the initial six-result setting but omits these additional memory reductions. Earlier CAD code can be shortened, and episodes can retain different amounts of history depending on context errors.

undeclared.decision: Discover evaluated conditions from existing directories instead of enumerating the declared model-by-toolset panel.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Missing parts receive zeros only within discovered conditions. A model server that exits before creating episode directories disappears entirely, and a missing toolset removes its model from the paired comparison. This changes which models the reported study represents.

undeclared.decision: Interpret absent validity metadata as successful validation.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The best-of pipeline reference is constructed with only iou and iou_cad. The report consequently displays zero invalid CADs and all parts having models through default-True lookups, although those validity facts were not supplied.

undeclared.decision: Use a paired percentile bootstrap over parts, with 10,000 resamples and seed 0, for 95% confidence intervals.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Neither the request nor ledger specifies an uncertainty model. These intervals describe resampling variation across the observed parts; they do not measure variation across repeated stochastic agent episodes.

undeclared.decision: Count skills as better or worse only when the absolute paired IoU(CAD) difference exceeds 0.01.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This introduces an undeclared practical-equivalence margin. Smaller improvements and regressions count as neither better nor worse.

undeclared.decision: Replay exported agent-written Python with an ordinary subprocess and unrestricted exec.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The exported program retains agent-written code. Scoring therefore executes that code outside the episode sandbox, with the scoring process's filesystem and network access. Being selected as the best geometry does not establish that the program is trusted.

undeclared.decision: Execute agent code as namespace root without dropping its namespace capabilities after configuring mounts.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Static inference: the child retains the capabilities needed to undo read-only remounts established in that same namespace. The write-confinement claim therefore depends on agent code leaving those mounts alone. This follows from the documented [user-namespace capability rules](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/user_namespaces.7.html) and [mount-locking rules](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/mount_namespaces.7.html).

undeclared.decision: Continue executing agent code after any read-only remount failure, without checking the resulting mount permissions.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A failed isolation operation is silently accepted as safe. The code does not establish that the affected mount was already read-only before proceeding.

stale_rows.stated_choice: Skills and code conditions are identical apart from skills/candidates; references are beamsec and the best-of section control.
stale_rows.actual_choice: The conditions also receive different strategy instructions: extract and fit sketches versus read sections for exact profiles. The scorer additionally includes fresh_beamkh.

stale_rows.stated_choice: 40 tool calls and 30 minutes per episode.
stale_rows.actual_choice: The call limit is checked between model turns, not between calls within a turn. A read-only execution check reproduced 41 calls with max-calls=40. The deadline is checked before tools start; an in-flight tool can finish and contribute results after it expires.

stale_rows.stated_choice: Failed or missing episodes score zero across the declared study.
stale_rows.actual_choice: Zero filling applies only to conditions whose directories exist. Entirely missing model/toolset conditions are omitted.
Concurrency is implemented in bench/agentsk_run.py using --toolsets and --jobs. The old runner remains sequential, always supplies --cands, and forwards unrecognized arguments to agent_loop.py.
Episode execution is wrapped, but CAD replay during scoring executes the exported agent code without that sandbox.

stale_rows.stated_choice: All mounts are remounted read-only and writes outside the workspace are blocked.
stale_rows.actual_choice: The implementation excludes /proc, /sys and /dev, ignores remount failures, and preserves the child's namespace capabilities. Its implementation does not provide the stated general write-confinement guarantee.

undeclared.decision: Cut every newly produced tool result to 6,000 characters before sending or recording it, without preserving valid JSON.
undeclared.why_it_matters: A-027 declares shortening older history, but this also limits the newest observation. Verified on 00140273: its cached extraction produces 13,494 characters, which become malformed, incomplete JSON. Geometry information is lost from both the model input and the transcript.

undeclared.decision: Rely on the sandbox backend to establish the replay working directory.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Round-1 unrestricted replay is fixed, but Linux backends change directory while the macOS backend does not. From the repository root, the existing /tmp/agentsk_spine/agent_model.py attempts its relative agent_model_cq.stl export outside the allowed directory. That permission failure is classified as an unbuilt CAD program and receives IoU(CAD)=0, making the score depend on the backend and invocation directory.

undeclared.decision: Assume the workspace survives mounting empty filesystems over /tmp, /var/tmp and /dev/shm.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The capability-drop and permission-verification fixes are present. However, a workspace beneath one of these paths is hidden before the subsequent bind mount uses it as its source. The SPEC's /tmp/agentsk_spine/work path therefore fails on the documented ORCD namespace fallback.

undeclared.decision: Average 'mean tool calls' over episodes with recorded call counts, while averaging tool-use 'calls/episode' over all study parts.
undeclared.why_it_matters: The two call summaries use different populations when episodes are missing. For one recorded 10-call episode among 20 parts, they can report 10 and 0.5 respectively. The ledger declares the all-part denominator for headline IoU but does not declare these differing effort denominators.

stale_rows.stated_choice: Extraction replies list the 20 largest profiles and count remaining profiles and dropped slivers.
stale_rows.actual_choice: Only fresh replies follow this rule. Cached replies return every sketch and omit the remaining-profile and dropped-sliver counts. Verified on 00140273: the first reply lists 20 with n_more_sketches=47; the repeat lists 67 without that count. The original area-filter defect is fixed, but the new reply contract is inconsistent.

stale_rows.stated_choice: The no-LLM policy fits all extracted sketches.
stale_rows.actual_choice: It processes only the returned sketches list and ignores n_more_sketches and more_sketch_ids. With the new display limit, only the first 20 profiles of a slice are considered even though additional sketch IDs exist. Thus the reply-size limit silently becomes a search restriction for this control.

stale_rows.stated_choice: Uncharged trial evaluations are recorded per part and reported; the policy is identified as a ceiling-style control.
stale_rows.actual_choice: The retained oracle access is now explicitly declared, and trial_evaluations is correctly written to result.json. However, the summary and scorer discard that field, and the report neither displays it nor identifies the additional oracle access. The reporting portion of the round-1 resolution remains unimplemented.
